host_layer: Bare-metal microcontroller with FreeRTOS tick scheduler
timing_definition: system_get_time() / micros() high-resolution microsecond timer around ML-KEM operations, converted to nanoseconds.
memory_definition: System free heap high-water mark via system_get_free_heap_size() / ESP.getFreeHeap() in bytes.
note: ESP8266 IoT physical silicon benchmark. Evaluated strictly on ML-KEM-512 due to 80KB SRAM boundary. All operations verified with 100% cryptographic memcmp match.
